module: Central module of the vehicle selector ("vehicleSelector" backend of ui_gridSelector). It builds the UI data (models, configs, filters), manages the persisted display options (/settings/vehicleSelectorData.json), filters, search, favorites and recent vehicles, then opens the selector in various contexts (freeroam, garage, challenge, configurator, pause) by changing the buttons and the breadcrumb root. It also drives the lifecycle of the pause/garage routes (root list and a vehicle's detail page) and sends snapshots to the interface. Most filter and detail functions delegate to filterModule, displayDataModule, ui_vehicleSelector_tiles and ui_vehicleSelector_detailsInteraction.
usage:
-- open the selector from a script and get the choice
ui_vehicleSelector_general.openVehicleSelectorForChallenge(function(model, config, extra)
  if model then log('I', '', model .. ' / ' .. tostring(config)) end
end)
notes: The displayData and filter instances are created on demand (setupInstances / ensureInstances); the display options format version is 11.
The UI data (getUiData) is rebuilt when vehicleDataChanged is true (mod enabled or disabled, mod manager, language change, clearCache).

Filters: allowed properties = Drivetrain, Config Type, Body Style, Transmission, Weight, Top Speed, 0-100 km/h, 0-60 mph, Power, Torque, Weight/Power, Years, Value, Brand, Country, Region, Source, Type, Derby Class, Performance Class, Off-Road Score, Propulsion, Fuel Type, Induction Type, Commercial Class. The range filters are Value, Weight, Top Speed, 0-100 km/h, 0-60 mph, Power, Torque, Weight/Power, Off-Road Score, Years; Region is a dictionary-type filter.
'Powerglow' configs are excluded except in the 'lightRunner' restriction mode (only Powerglow, Car or Truck). The 'busRoute' mode keeps only Body Style = Bus and Commercial Class = Transit Bus.
The spawnOnly mode is reset to false when leaving the selector route family, and on close (closedFromUI).
Most functions that accept a requestId then emit a 'vehicleSelectorDisplayDataSnapshot' snapshot; without a requestId (nil) nothing is emitted.
Probable bug: in vehiclePassesFilters, the range test `not type(propVal) == 'number'` is always false (precedence of `not`), so it does not guard against non-numeric values.

Probable bug: vehiclePassesFilters reads config.infoFilename without checking that config exists (the code does handle the "no config" case just before): error if showCustomPCFiles is disabled and config is nil.
M.getDisplayData is defined twice (same behavior). The M.p field is a fake profiler (empty start, add, finish); profilerFinish does nothing because M.p.timer does not exist.
Debug traces left in: navigateToVehicle does dump() calls, and the openVehicleSelectorForFreeroamModal callback dumps its 4 arguments.

p.desc: Dummy profiler (emptyProfiler) with no-op start, add and finish.

setVehicleRestrictionMode.desc: Sets a hard vehicle type restriction applied on top of the filters: 'lightRunner', 'busRoute' or nil (none).

setSpawnOnly.desc: Enables the "spawn only" mode; any value other than true disables it.

isSpawnOnly.desc: Returns whether spawn-only mode is active.

isFreeroamVehicleSelectorContext.desc: True if the current UI route is one of the freeroam vehicle selector screens or the freeroam wizard (freeroamLevels.vehicles, freeroamWizard.vehicles and menu./pause. variants).

getDisplayData.desc: Returns the effective display options. In freeroam context, showRecentMode takes the value of showRecentModeFreeroamSelector.

returns.desc: Display options table (groupMode, sortMode, clusterMode, expandGroups, displaySize, ...).

getDisplayDataOptions.desc: Returns the list of display options offered to the UI, hiding showRecentMode or showRecentModeFreeroamSelector depending on the context.

setDisplayDataOption.desc: Modifies a display option (persisted if save=true); emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

requestId.desc: UI request identifier for the return snapshot.

resetDisplayDataToDefaults.desc: Resets the display options to their default values.

getUiData.desc: Returns the selector's UI data (models, configs, filterList, filterByProp, lockedFiltersByProp, activeFilters, displayData, displayInfo), recomputing it if needed.

emptyProfiler.desc: Creates a fake profiler whose start, add and finish do nothing.

profilerFinish.desc: Ends or marks a step of the M.p profiler. No effect with the default fake profiler.

onModDeactivated.desc: Hook: a mod is deactivated; forces a reload of the selector data.

onModActivated.desc: Hook: a mod is activated; forces a reload of the selector data.

onModManagerReady.desc: Hook: the mod manager is ready; forces a data reload.

onModManagerStateChanged.desc: Hook: the mod manager state has changed; forces a data reload.

clearCache.desc: Forces the UI data and display options to be rebuilt on next access.

onLanguageChanged.desc: Hook: the language changes; forces a reload (translated labels).

onfilechanged.desc: File watching hook: forgets the settings/default.pc cache when that file changes.

getDefaultVehicleInfo.desc: Reads and caches settings/default.pc (legacy default vehicle).

returns.desc: File contents, or nil if absent or unreadable.

getDefaultVehicleTile.desc: Builds the "Legacy default.pc" tile for the grid, from the model indicated by settings/default.pc.

returns.desc: Tile, or nil if the file or model is not found.

closedFromUI.desc: To call when the selector closes: resets the breadcrumb root, spawn-only, detail state, locked filters, buttons, exit callback, then emits the onVehicleSelectorClosed hook.

getFilters.desc: Initializes the UI data if needed then returns the filters (filterList, filterByProp, lockedFiltersByProp).

getActiveFilters.desc: Delegates to the filter module: returns the active filters.

getSearchText.desc: Returns the current search text (filter module).

setSearchText.desc: Sets the search text; emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

toggleFavourite.desc: Adds or removes a vehicle from favorites ('model/config' key). For settings/default.pc, toggles the includeDefaultConfigInFavourites option instead.

itemDetails.desc: Table with the fields model and config.

returns.desc: true if the item is now a favorite.

toggleFilter.desc: Enables or disables a value of a set-type filter; emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

updateRangeFilter.desc: Sets the bounds of a range filter; emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

resetRangeFilter.desc: Resets a range filter to its full bounds; emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

resetSetFilter.desc: Resets a set-type filter to its default state; emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

lockFilter.desc: Locks a filter so the user cannot change it (delegates to the filter module).

unlockFilter.desc: Unlocks a filter (delegates to the filter module).

isFilterLocked.desc: Returns whether a filter is locked.

lockFilterMode.desc: Locks a filter in inclusion mode (delegates to the filter module).

lockFilterModeExclusive.desc: Locks a filter in exclusive mode with the list of allowed values (delegates to the filter module).

calculateActiveFilters.desc: Recomputes the list of active filters (delegates to the filter module).

setupValidFilters.desc: Prepares the list of valid filters for a filtering pass (delegates to the filter module).

getValidFilters.desc: Returns the prepared valid filters (delegates to the filter module).

createFilters.desc: Builds the list of UI filters (range or set types) from a list of configs, according to the property whitelist.

....desc: List of configs (first argument), passed to createVehicleFilters.

passesFilters.desc: Returns whether an item passes the filters and the search (delegates to the filter module).

isFavourite.desc: Returns whether the model/config pair is a favorite.

isRecentVehicle.desc: Returns whether the model/config pair is among the recent vehicles.

trackRecentVehicle.desc: Records the model/config pair as a recent vehicle.

getRecentVehicles.desc: Returns the list of recent vehicles.

goToMod.desc: Delegates to detailsInteraction.goToMod: opens the mod's page.

getDetails.desc: Delegates to detailsInteraction.getDetails: details and buttons of an item.

getScreenHeaderTitleAndPath.desc: Computes the header title and the breadcrumb segments according to the current path, the active filters and the search. Titles are suffixed "(filtered)" if a filter or search is active, and replaced by "Spawn Vehicle" in spawn-only mode.

path.desc: Path {keys = {...}}; keys[1] is allModels, configsForModel or configsForBrandSubModelOrModel.

isOpenedFromGarage.desc: Returns whether the selector was opened from the garage.

openVehicleSelectorForFreeroam.desc: Opens the menu's full-screen selector (route 'menu.vehiclesnew') with management buttons and freeroam buttons, then emits onVehicleSelectorOpen.

openVehicleSelectorForFreeroamWithMod.desc: Like openVehicleSelectorForFreeroam, but filters the source on a given mod.

openVehicleSelectorForGarage.desc: Opens the selector from the garage (routes 'garage.mycars' or 'garage.vehicles'). A "Load" button replaces the current vehicle (or enters a career inventory vehicle), records the recent, then returns to the garage. Locks the source (Custom, Mod, Career or BeamNG - Official).

showOwnedOnly.desc: true to show only owned vehicles (Custom, Mod, Career).

openVehicleSelectorForFreeroamModal.desc: Opens the selector in "modal" mode: a "Select Vehicle" button (and the exit) send back to 'menu.freeroamselector'. Management buttons disabled.

openVehicleSelectorForChallenge.desc: Opens the selector to choose an opposing vehicle. Unless options.unrestricted, props and trailers are excluded by a lock on the Type filter. The callback receives (model, config, additionalData) on selection, and no argument on exit.

callback.desc: Function called with the selection or with no argument if the user exits.

options.desc: options.unrestricted = true to clear all filters.

openVehicleSelectorForFreeroamConfigurat.desc: Opens the selector for the freeroam configurator (route 'menu.vehiclesnew'). The callback receives (model, config, additionalData) and the vehicle is recorded as recent.

openFromPause.desc: Opens the selector from the pause menu. Refused (returns false) if an active first drive session does not allow vehicleManagement.

options.desc: options.spawnOnly (boolean) and options.focusSearch (focuses the search on open).

consumeFocusSearchOnOpen.desc: Returns then resets to false the "focus the search on open" flag set by openFromPause.

returns.desc: true if the search should be focused.

clearDrilldownSelectorState.desc: Resets the pending or active vehicle selection and the path set by setCurrentSelectorPath, so that a new snapshot is not rebuilt on an old vehicle.

requestDetails.desc: Computes the details of a tile (via getDetails) and sends them to the UI via 'vehicleSelectorDetails'. Cluster tiles without showDetails are ignored (warning logged).

item.desc: Tile with showDetails = {model, config}, or directly {model, config}.

requestId.desc: Request identifier returned in the payload.

returns.desc: Payload {backendName, requestId, item, details}, or nil.

asyncVehicleLoadComplete.desc: Hook called by util_asyncBulkLoader when the asynchronous vehicle loading is finished: builds and emits the pending snapshot (VehicleSelectorDataLoaded), unless the route changed in the meantime.

navigateToVehicle.desc: Goes from the grid to a vehicle's detail page: stores the selection (path, title, model, config) and navigates to the child route matching the current root route (pause or garage).

onVehicleRouteEnter.desc: Route hook: entering a vehicle's detail page. Promotes the pending selection to the active selection.

onVehicleRouteMount.desc: Route hook: mounting the detail page; starts the asynchronous loading then the emission of the active selection's path snapshot.

onVehicleRouteLeave.desc: Route hook: leaving the detail page; resets spawn-only to false if the destination is outside the selector family.

onRootRouteEnter.desc: Route hook: entering a selector root screen (pause, garage); clears the detail state.

onRootRouteMount.desc: Route hook: mounting a root screen; starts the asynchronous loading then the emission of the snapshot for the route's path (default allModels).

onRootRouteLeave.desc: Route hook: leaving a root screen; resets spawn-only to false outside the family, and if opened from the garage clears locks and filters.

setCurrentSelectorPath.desc: Records a selector path chosen by a wizard, used by emitDisplayDataSnapshot. nil clears it; accepts {keys = {...}} or a direct list.

resolveCurrentSelectorPath.desc: Returns the current path: the path set by setCurrentSelectorPath, otherwise that of the active selection, otherwise {keys = {'allModels'}}.

emitDisplayDataSnapshot.desc: Rebuilds the selector snapshot for the current path and sends it via 'vehicleSelectorDisplayDataSnapshot'.

resolveSelectedVehicleTitle.desc: Returns the title of the selected vehicle (active selection) for the route's dynamic title, otherwise the title passed as a parameter.
